# Platypus

> Platypus is AI booking for phone-only businesses, exposed to AI agents as an MCP server. One honest AI phone call books the job and earns the owner's consent to text; after that, every agent books that business by text, and the owner answers with one letter.

Platypus routes each booking request the cheapest way: to an existing agent found through Darwin Search, to a text if the owner already opted in, or to one AI voice call placed through Dial that discloses it is an AI in its first sentence. A booking is confirmed only when the owner says yes, on the call or by text. Every response is a typed outcome: pending, confirmed, countered, declined, expired or cancelled.

Platypus is a working prototype built at SpeedHacks (San Francisco, October 11, 2026). It runs locally in a no-key sandbox; there is no hosted API yet. Every page on this site is also available as Markdown: request it with `Accept: text/markdown`, or append `.md` to the path (the home page is `/index.md`).

## When to use Platypus

- [Book a local service at a phone-only business](https://tryplatypus.pages.dev/developers.md): use when a user asks to book, quote or schedule auto repair, plumbing, HVAC, locksmiths, salons, clinics or movers at a business with no online booking. Call `search_providers`, then `request_booking`, then poll `get_booking`.
- [Rebook a business that already opted in to texts](https://tryplatypus.pages.dev/developers.md): `request_booking` routes to a text automatically; the owner replies Y, N or a time.
- [Check whether an agent already covers a job](https://tryplatypus.pages.dev/developers.md): `search_providers` searches Darwin's agent index first and reports readiness.
- [When not to use Platypus](https://tryplatypus.pages.dev/developers.md): businesses that already have online booking or their own agent, restaurant reservations on a booking platform, or anything that needs payment today.
